name: Dzhankoi-Feodosia-Kerch Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no page states the pipeline's own length. Only a lower bound of 247 km (the Kerch Strait line was to join it at its km 247) and an unverified 268.3 km figure that no fetched page confirms. The 500 km figure on the Chernomorneftegaz page is the added length of the Armyansk-Dzhankoi trunk, the Dzhankoi-Feodosia-Kerch trunk and branch lines together, not this pipe. Sponsor and endpoints are clear.
researcher_notes: Not in the GEM roster: none of the 47 Ukraine gas rows has a Dzhankoi, Feodosia, Kerch or Crimea end. It is a different pipe from the 2016 Kuban-Crimea line (krasnodar-krai-crimea), which crosses the Kerch Strait and was staged as a new row in the Russia run. The 2014 Black Sea Oil and Gas (Chernomorneftegaz) plan says the new strait line would tie into this older trunk at its km 247. What is confirmed: the trunk is a Crimean main line with 500 mm diameter (neftegaz.ru analysis of the Chernomorneftegaz system, 2015), put into operation in 1999 according to the Naftogaz of Ukraine history page. A neftegaz.ru news item from May 2014 says it was built in 2000, and a Ukrainian Cabinet order of 17 November 2001 (no. 519-r) named a state commission to accept the finished pipeline, so the start year is 1999 to 2001 depending on source; 1999 staged as the operator's own history. It was run by Ukrtransgaz (Kharkivtransgaz, Kherson pipeline operating unit) until March 2014 and then taken over by Chernomorneftegaz under Russian-installed administration; that operator is the occupying-power builder/operator, not a Ukrainian operator, so Owner left blank pending the ownership team. Territory: wholly inside occupied Crimea, so a Ukraine row. Status operating: the 2016 tie-ins and the 2023 reports of Crimean grid use say it is in service. Length is the only missing leg of the add-threshold. To close it, find a Ukrtransgaz or Chernomorneftegaz document, or the 2001 Cabinet order text, that states the length. If a source gives 268.3 km it clears the 25 km rule and the row can be added. Route not researched. Confidence medium.
